content.short: Endaoment Subgraph provides a GraphQL API to extract on-chain data from the Endaoment protocol.
content.description: Endaoment Subgraph indexes and organizes data from Endaoment Foundation smart contracts, providing a consistent, queryable view of on-chain activity. It exposes essential details including contract addresses, transaction formats, and statistics about grants, donations, and Donor Advised Funds (DAFs). Developers can leverage this data to build applications, dashboards, and visualizations that illuminate grant flows, funding patterns, and donor activity, enabling deeper exploration of Endaoment's philanthropic programs and impact.
